name: Childrens Story
description: Writes children's stories for specific age groups (picture book, early reader, middle grade) with age-appropriate language, clear narrative structure, and themes that respect young readers' intelligence. Use when the user asks to write a children's story, kids' book, bedtime story, picture book text, or story for young readers. Do NOT use for young adult fiction (use short-story-writing with YA parameters), educational content for children (use lesson-plan-design), or adult fiction with childlike themes (use short-story-writing).
